content_blocks.text: In the heart of the city lies a hidden gem, a community center that has been serving the less fortunate for over a decade. Tonight, the Beacon shines a spotlight on the unsung heroes behind this beacon of hope. Meet LUCY, a single mother who volunteers every weekend to help feed the homeless. Her smile is warm, her spirit unbreakable. Lucy says, 'Every person deserves a chance, no matter their circumstances.' This year, she was nominated for the Community Hero Award, a recognition that highlights the tireless efforts of those who make a difference in our community.
